## Finding: work order identified; late-event determination remains unverified

The relevant manufacturing order is **MO-25-09-1070**, corresponding to **work order WO-2025-09-004** for the **Cooler Plate Pack** at Modine’s Racine–DeKoven operation.

| Review item | Verified result |
|---|---|
| Cost period | **Sep-25 — PER-COST-2025-09** |
| Recorded period status | **PENDING_CLOSE** |
| Exact Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Source transaction | Not available in the accessible records |
| Event amount | Not verifiable |
| Exact event-created time | Not verifiable |
| Minutes after Pending Close | Cannot calculate without the event-created timestamp |
| Recorded accounting status | Not verifiable |
| Status consistent with Oracle policy? | Cannot conclude without the event details and recorded status |

The supplied Task records contain the work order and cost period, but **no cost-event rows**. The event-level supporting records were unavailable: the service returned “supporting records not staged,” and access metadata restricts them to the records-custodian role. This is an evidence limitation—not evidence that no late event occurred. The Pending Close timestamp has no timezone offset in the source.

### Oracle’s documented treatment

Oracle’s *Supply Chain Cost Management 26B*, **“Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting”** (PDF page 233; printed page 225), states that newly created transactions falling in the Pending Close period or an earlier period **are not staged or processed until the period is closed or reopened**. Transactions entered before Pending Close continue processing. **Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions** and continue processing.

Accordingly, determining whether a recorded accounting status is consistent requires the event’s **type, creation timestamp, and status**. An authorized extract of the cost events for **WO-2025-09-004** is needed to finish that assessment.

**The review was read-only; no database records were changed.**

The September 2025 month-end close team is reviewing manufacturing cost activity in Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B for Modine's Racine operation. Please investigate the cost activity associated with the work order for the September manufacturing order ending in 1070 and determine whether any event was created after the September cost period entered Pending Close.

Your final response must identify the relevant work order and source transaction, state the event's amount, give the exact event-created time and the exact Pending Close time, calculate how late the event was, report its recorded accounting status, and conclude whether that status is consistent with Oracle's documented Pending Close treatment for newly created transactions. Keep the review read-only and do not change any database records.
